note: Vineyard RV park on a working cattle ranch in the Sandhills south of Nenzel, near Merritt Reservoir and a certified Dark Sky area. The sites are a gravel oval of pull-through strips north of the tasting room, open prairie with no shade. Vehicles stay off the grass. --Claude
summary: Operator page read today: 12 pull-through sites, 20/30/50 A + water (no sewer), shower house, restrooms, free wifi, dump 7 mi away in Cody Park; May 1 - Nov 22 (off-season by phone); 7-night limit; $38 (military/seniors/Harvest Hosts $28). All groups now manual; military discount added. Gate passes ($38). Presence: website + phone, Google 4.9/68. Pin ~510 m off: re-pin. Not waterfront.
flags: PIN MOVE: stored 42.90890,-101.08844 is on the county road SW of the winery building. The RV park is the gravel oval of pull-through strips ~510 m NE, centre 42.91125,-101.08310 (Esri imagery; it matches the page's 12 sites). Google's point for the winery is 42.90886,-101.08691.
RATINGS: Google 4.9 from 68 reviews (the winery listing); RV Life 8.38/10 from 10 ratings ($$ tier, avg $37). Not in the Good Sam directory. No drop.

PRICE GATE: $38 passes (no gateway within 40 km; nearest is Badlands NP at 116 km). Two RV Life camper reports (7/2026 and 9/2026, motorhomes) paid $60, against the posted $38 plus tax and other 2026 reports of $28-30. Possibly an add-on or a mistaken entry; the operator's posted rate stands.

SAND RULE: not a candidate. The pads are a graded gravel oval ('Vehicles are not permitted on grass, roadway, or unregistered campsites'); nothing says sand driving. Imagery shows the oval and its approach as graded gravel; I found nothing on the access road's surface.

BOOKING: the site's only Peek link (https://book.peek.com/s/98dee8ac-4132-44e3-994c-35d51a624f8d/1J64K) is labelled 'Book a Tasting'; RV reservations are by phone, 402-823-4131 (stored, also Google's). Website https://nvv-ne.com/rv-park is current.
